evidence_items.claim: UBS participated in ISDA/Digital Asset CDM clearing pilot using DAML (October 2020). Vinay Srinivas (MD, APAC Head of Quant Analytics and Digital Transformation) provided endorsement.
evidence_items.excerpt: ASX and UBS have been providing input to validate additional functionality of the CDM alongside ISDA and Digital Asset. Vinay Srinivas, UBS: 'ISDA is driving an important industry wide initiative... I am confident that the initiative will provide clarity on to what extent the CDM in DAML can be leveraged for cleared derivatives.'
evidence_items.caveats: Evidence is from October 2020 (over 4 years old). Pilot was for DLT/DAML integration specifically. No follow-up evidence of continued engagement or production progression.

evidence_items.claim: Credit Suisse had CDM involvement - Sunil Challa presented at OSFF CDM panel. This capability was inherited via acquisition.
evidence_items.excerpt: Sunil Challa of Credit Suisse participated in a panel of experts at OSFF New York alongside Jon Nance of Axoni, Dianne Boyle of Symbiont, and Eleonora Acuna of ISDA, to delve into the possibilities of CDM in the real world.
evidence_items.caveats: Credit Suisse capability may or may not be retained post-merger. No evidence of UBS continuing Credit Suisse CDM work. Integration consuming all capacity.

evidence_items.claim: UBS Credit Suisse integration is the 'largest migration of data as part of an M&A transaction in financial services' - consuming massive technology capacity
evidence_items.excerpt: UBS expects to migrate 1.3 million clients overall, described as 'the largest migration of data as part of an M&A transaction in financial services, if not the biggest overall.' CEO flagged IT integration as one of the biggest risks.
evidence_items.caveats: Confirms integration-constrained hypothesis. All technology capacity consumed by migration through 2026.

evidence_items.claim: Risk.net Derivatives House of the Year 2024 - Strong derivatives performance but no CDM mention
evidence_items.excerpt: Derivatives and solutions ahead 43% year-over-year. 'I would say, without reservation, at this moment in time, I think we have the strongest platform we have ever had.' - Dushyant Chadha, global head of derivatives and solutions
evidence_items.caveats: Strong derivatives performance but technology focus is on integration, not CDM. No CDM mentioned in coverage.

null_results.implication: No current UBS CDM contribution despite historical pilot participation
No CDM activity since 2020 pilot - stalled during integration

hesitations_against.description: Credit Suisse integration consuming all technology capacity through 2026
hesitations_against.notes: Hypothesis CONFIRMED - largest data migration in financial services history

net_assessment.rationale: Historical CDM pilot (2020) shows capability and interest. Integration constraint means no capacity for CDM work until 2026+.

knowledge_gaps.description: Will UBS revive CDM work after integration completes?
knowledge_gaps.impact_rationale: 2020 pilot shows capability - question is whether they will restart

suggested_sources.target_role: Head of Derivatives Technology or Vinay Srinivas
suggested_sources.discovery_question: Will UBS restart CDM initiatives after Credit Suisse integration?
